environment.label: chrome
environment.mode: headless (--headless=new), driven via CDP; no physical display/device
environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
environment.glslVersion: WebGL GLSL ES 3.00 (OpenGL ES GLSL ES 3.0 Chromium)

results.name: Standalone document: WebGL 2.0 initialised and rendering
results.procedure: Open /modules/module1-webgl/index.html over HTTP @1280x800; wait for frames
results.expected: hasWebGL2, shader+VAO+VBO+EBO present, meshMode=pccase, 13 draws, frameCount grows, status 'WebGL 2.0 Active', non-clear pixels

results.name: Single rendering loop (own rAF vs module frameCount, 2 s)
results.procedure: Count independent rAF callbacks and module frameCount increments over 2 s
results.expected: ratio ≈ 1.0 (a duplicate loop would give ≈ 2.0)

results.name: Relative paths/assets: no HTTP >= 400 and no console errors while loading standalone module
results.procedure: Network.responseReceived + console/exception capture during load
results.expected: 0 failing requests (favicon.ico excluded), 0 console errors, 0 exceptions

results.name: Triangle: 3 vertices, drawArrays, non-indexed, vertex colours interpolate
results.procedure: Select Triangle via #control-mesh-mode; stop rotation; sample pixels near each vertex and at centroid
results.expected: vertexCount=3, no EBO, draws=1, caption mentions drawArrays, each vertex region dominated by its own colour channel, centroid is a blend

observed.caption: 1 Draw Call (gl.drawArrays) · 3 Vertices · Barycentric Color Interpolation

results.name: Cube: indexed VBO/EBO/VAO, 36 indices, MVP valid, faces distinguishable, depth test occludes back faces
results.procedure: Select Cube; Auto-Rotate off; rotation (0,0,0); sample centres of +X,+Y,+Z faces and the hidden -X face
results.expected: 24v/36i, 1 draw, DEPTH_TEST enabled, 3 visible face colours pairwise distinct, hidden -X centre pixel != -X face colour

results.name: PC Case default: 13 parts, 1 shared geometry, 13 draw calls
results.procedure: Reload standalone; read diagnostics
results.expected: partCount=13, visible=13, draws=13, compiles=1, allocs=1, VBO=576 B, EBO=72 B

results.name: Root transform moves/rotates all 13 parts
results.procedure: setAutoRotate(false); setModelTranslation(0.3,0,0) and compare every part worldMatrix translation column
results.expected: all 13 parts shift by exactly +0.3 in world X (translation is the last matrix applied)

results.name: Sub-assembly transform affects only its component group
results.procedure: setSubAssemblyTransform('front_panel',{translation:[0,0,0.32]}); compare world translations before/after
results.expected: exactly the 7 front_panel parts change; the other 6 are unchanged

results.name: Individual part transform affects only the selected part
results.procedure: setPartTransform('power_button',{translation:[0.14,0.6,0.6]}); compare all parts
results.expected: only power_button's worldMatrix changes

results.name: Component visibility changes draw-call count
results.procedure: Hide side_glass_panel, then group 'accent', then restore all

results.name: Colour customisation changes GPU output, then Reset restores defaults
results.procedure: setPartColor('all','#ff0000') and sample pixel; then resetScene() and compare all parts with the initial snapshot
results.expected: R-dominant pixel at screen centre after change; after reset every part's id/transform/visibility/colour equals the snapshot

results.name: Real DOM controls: scene selector, Auto-Rotate, Speed, Colour target/picker, Default Palette, Pause/Resume, Reset
results.procedure: Drive each control through its DOM element/event and verify diagnostics + rotation rate
results.expected: each control changes the matching state; rotation rate ≈ configured speed; pause freezes frameCount; resume restarts; reset restores defaults

results.name: Cube face colour via UI (target '0' = +Z) reaches the GPU
results.procedure: Cube scene, target Front(+Z), colour #00ff00, sample +Z face centre
results.expected: G-dominant pixel at +Z face centre

results.name: Unsupported-WebGL fallback (?webgl=unsupported)
results.procedure: Open module with ?webgl=unsupported
results.expected: fallback overlay visible, no WebGL context created, no uncaught exceptions

results.name: Genuine WebGL2-less browser (not simulated)
results.procedure: Disable hardware acceleration / use a browser without WebGL2
results.expected: fallback overlay
results.observed: Only the simulated URL switch (LC-1) was exercised; no real WebGL2-less environment available.

results.name: Shader compilation failure → error overlay → recoverable by Reset
results.procedure: testShaderCompileError(undefined,false) then (undefined,true); then resetScene()
results.expected: isolated test returns ok:false + info log; applied test shows #shader-error-overlay, stops loop; resetScene() hides overlay, resumes 13 draws

observed.isolatedErrorHead:
[GLSL VERTEX_SHADER Compilation Failed]
ERROR: 0:5: '}' : syntax error

results.name: GPU resource (buffer) allocation failure injected via gl.createBuffer override
results.procedure: Override gl.createBuffer to return null on the live context; setMeshMode('triangle'); restore; resetScene()
results.expected: no uncaught exception; failure surfaced via overlay/diagnostics; loop not running without resources; recovery after restoring createBuffer + reset

fail.lastErr: Failed to allocate WebGLBuffer (gl.createBuffer returned null).

results.name: Context loss/restore while running (WEBGL_lose_context)
results.procedure: Customise (colour, sub-assembly, speed 90); loseContext(); restoreContext(); compare state & counters
results.expected: loop stops + overlay on loss; on restore GPU resources rebuilt (compile/alloc +1) and the user's pause/run preference, colour, sub-assembly and speed are preserved; no duplicate loop

results.name: Context loss/restore while PAUSED (WEBGL_lose_context)
results.procedure: Customise (colour, sub-assembly, speed 90); loseContext(); restoreContext(); compare state & counters
results.expected: loop stops + overlay on loss; on restore GPU resources rebuilt (compile/alloc +1) and the user's pause/run preference, colour, sub-assembly and speed are preserved; no duplicate loop

results.name: Scene switching: resource reuse vs rebuild (counters)
results.procedure: Record shaderCompileCount/geometryAllocCount across pccase→cube→pccase→triangle→pccase
results.expected: pccase↔cube reuse (Δ=0); switching to/from triangle rebuilds (observed Δ recorded)

results.name: No duplicate rAF loops after stress (30 pause/resume, 30 scene switches, 10 resets)
results.procedure: Stress calls then measure loopRatio over 2 s
results.expected: ratio ≈ 1.0; single animationFrameId

results.name: GPU memory / leak measurement
results.procedure: Requires vendor GPU profiler or browser task manager over long runs
results.expected: stable GPU memory over repeated create/destroy cycles
results.observed: No GPU-memory instrument was used. Counters (shaderCompileCount, geometryAllocCount) count JS-side API calls only and cannot prove absence of leaks.

results.name: Canvas CSS size, drawing buffer, viewport, aspect, DPR cap across 8 viewports × DPR {1,1.5,2,3} (fresh loads)
results.procedure: For each combination read canvas CSS size, buffer size, gl.VIEWPORT, projection aspect (P[5]/P[0]), horizontal overflow, PC Case bounding box
results.expected: buffer = round(css × min(max(dpr,1),2)); viewport = [0,0,buffer]; projection aspect = buffer aspect (±0.01); no horizontal overflow; PC Case lit pixels > 0

results.name: Live resize (no reload) tracks container, viewport and aspect
results.procedure: On one loaded page sweep the 8 viewports (DPR 1) via emulation resize; read state after each
results.expected: buffer == css at DPR 1; viewport == buffer; projection aspect == buffer aspect; canvas non-blank

results.name: Narrow-viewport usability (measured, standalone DPR 1)
results.procedure: Measure instrument bar, control panel and canvas heights at 390x844, 375x667, 320x568; check PC Case bbox and controls inside viewport
results.expected: Controls reachable (no horizontal overflow, none outside viewport); PC Case lit area present. Canvas height is recorded as a limitation indicator

results.name: Direct #/module1: iframe load event vs WebGL initialisation vs first rendered frames
results.procedure: Open /index.html#/module1 @1440x900; record time to iframe load and to frameCount>2; check overlays
results.expected: iframe src ./modules/module1-webgl/index.html; loading/error overlays hidden; WebGL active; frames advancing; 13 draws

results.name: Overview → Module 1 via sidebar link
results.procedure: Open index.html (#/), click .nav-item[data-nav-route='#/module1']
results.expected: hash becomes #/module1; module view shown; WebGL active in iframe

results.name: Module 1 → Module 2 → Module 1: teardown (pagehide/destroy) and fresh single-loop re-entry
results.procedure: Install pagehide spy in module doc; click Module 2 then Module 1 links; inspect spy and new document
results.expected: old document received pagehide and destroyed GPU resources/loop (no program, no rAF id); new document fresh (compile=1), single loop ratio ≈ 1

results.name: Module Reload button
results.procedure: Click #module-reload-btn; inspect the new document
results.expected: iframe reloads (new window object, frameCount restarts, compile=1), WebGL active, single loop

results.name: Hidden-iframe behaviour: leave module route to Overview (iframe kept alive) and return
results.procedure: Click Overview; sample module frameCount/canvas for 1 s while hidden; click Module 1 again
results.expected: Observation test: records whether frames continue while hidden, the canvas size while hidden and that rendering/size recover on return

results.name: Desktop sidebar collapse/expand keeps aspect ratio and rendering
results.procedure: At 1440x900 click #sidebar-collapse-btn twice; read iframe canvas CSS size/buffer/aspect each time
results.expected: canvas width grows when collapsed and shrinks back; buffer == css (DPR 1); projection aspect tracks width/height; PC Case still lit

results.name: Mobile drawer open/close (390x844) and canvas after close
results.procedure: Set 390x844 mobile emulation; click #menu-toggle-btn; verify #sidebar.is-open; close via #sidebar-close-btn and via Escape; read canvas
results.expected: drawer opens/closes (button + Escape); module canvas stays valid and rendering

results.name: Refresh while #/module1 is active
results.procedure: Page.reload on #/module1 @1440x900
results.expected: route preserved; iframe reloaded; WebGL active again

results.name: Viewport sweep inside the Portal (iframe canvas dimensions)
results.procedure: Resize through the 8 viewports on #/module1 and read the iframe canvas
results.expected: canvas non-trivial and buffer == css at DPR 1; PC Case lit; no horizontal overflow in iframe document

results.name: Portal under GitHub Pages sub-path hosting
results.procedure: Serve from /<repo>/ prefix on a real GitHub Pages deployment
results.expected: relative paths resolve under the repository URL
results.observed: Phase 8 (deployment) is out of scope for Task 3.6; only a root-path local HTTP server (127.0.0.1) was used. Source paths are relative (./ and ../).

results.name: Per-mode measurements (1280x800, DPR 1, 3 s rAF window + 200-iteration CPU loops)
results.env: chrome Chrome/157.0.8103.39, headless(new), CDP; WebGL renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x00009A68) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
results.procedure: setMeshMode(mode); independent rAF interval statistics; average CPU time of 200 × stepAnimationBySeconds (JS update + draw submission + telemetry DOM write) and 200 × sampleCenterPixel (draw submission + synchronous readPixels, which forces the GPU/driver to finish the frame)
results.expected: Recorded values only (no pass threshold): used to compare modes and to show measurement limits

results.name: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 GPU timing
results.procedure: Wrap one frame in a TIME_ELAPSED query for each mode
results.expected: GPU nanoseconds if the extension exists

results.procedure: Collected Runtime.consoleAPICalled(error), Runtime.exceptionThrown and Log.entryAdded(error) per phase
